scenarios.name: update-customer-11-vsam-only
scenarios.why: customer 11 is on KSDSCUST (ksdscust-vsam-only.txt, appended) but not in Db2's CUSTOMER: the UPDATE is +100 (l.173 true), CA-RETURN-CODE '01', no '90' and no WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE; LGUCVS01 is still LINKed and its READ UPDATE / REWRITE of customer 11 are NORMAL -- the two stores out of step, as GenApp's design allows

scenarios.name: no-commarea
scenarios.why: EIBCALEN 0: IF EIBCALEN IS EQUAL TO ZERO -- EM-VARIABLE ' NO COMMAREA RECEIVED', WRITE-ERROR-MESSAGE LINKs LGSTSQ with ERROR-MSG (it writes the message to TD CSMT and TS GENAERRS: #4607), IF EIBCALEN > 0 is false, then ABEND LGCA

scenarios.name: wrong-request-id
scenarios.why: CA-REQUEST-ID '01ICUS' is not '01UCUS': CA-RETURN-CODE '99', GO TO END-PROGRAM (no LINK)

notes: Generated-row sibling (#4507) of genapp-lgucus01: GenApp's update-customer front end (LGUCUS01, LINKed with the 32500-byte LGCMAREA COMMAREA) LINKs LGUCDB01 in the same task (which LINKs LGUCVS01, and LGSTSQ on errors) on the ten CUSTOMER rows (numbers 1..10) of genapp-lgucdb01-generated, generated from base/cntl/db2cre.jcl (seed 4507), plus customer 11 on KSDSCUST only. The 16 generated requests are those of genapp-lgucdb01-generated (found and missing customer numbers, request ids that are not '01UCUS' and stop at the front end with '99'); stated: a 100-byte email, the VSAM-only customer 11 (UPDATE +100, '01'), no-commarea (EIBCALEN 0: LGSTSQ, ABEND LGCA) and a wrong request id. The injected -913 / -811 on the UPDATE stay genapp-lgucdb01-generated's.
